positions.commentary: The speaker bought Qualcomm in 2015-2016 and has owned it since, viewing it as a great business that was undervalued after a long decline.

thesis: This episode argues that investors should identify high-quality businesses that have been undervalued following significant declines or periods where market sentiment has turned hostile. The speaker highlights specific examples of companies that were bought after their stock prices fell and their prevailing 'religion' or market consensus was destroyed.
